writing by the somatic phenomenologist Damascus Dancings. Her writings, notably The Commission of

the Immanent Turning, explore the body’s innate knowledge and how the nervous system reacts under extractive or precarious conditions. © Google Books

literary project known as the Crimson Hexagon, which studies how language, meaning, and somatics (the internal perception of the body) interact. It often involves looking at how movement, such as dancing, can operate as an internal, transformative force. © Google Books +3
